subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Lan Han is a Chinese American textile artist.
• Between 1998 and 2022, she created more than 40 large-scale tapestry installations for public buildings across North America.
• She unveiled Threads of the Yangtze at the Boston Public Library on March 12, 2004.
• She unveiled Prairie Loom at the Denver Art Museum on October 8, 2011.
• Both tapestries belong to her River Cycle series.
• High-resolution images of the tapestries are available on the museums' online archives.
prompt: Which choice most effectively uses information from the given sentences to begin a narration of Han's creation of Threads of the Yangtze?

choices.A: It was on March 12, 2004, at the Boston Public Library, that Lan Han unveiled a new addition to her River Cycle series: the large-scale tapestry Threads of the Yangtze.
choices.B: Lan Han unveiled Threads of the Yangtze in March of 2004 and Prairie Loom in October of 2011.
choices.C: While both tapestries created by Lan Han belong to her River Cycle series, Threads of the Yangtze was unveiled at the Boston Public Library and Prairie Loom was unveiled at the Denver Art Museum.
choices.D: Dozens of large-scale tapestries created for public buildings across North America by Lan Han can now be viewed in one place: the museums' online archives.

explanation:
Choice A is the best answer. This choice introduces Han and the Threads of the Yangtze tapestry in an active and specific way, establishing the precise date (March 12, 2004) and location (Boston Public Library) to set the scene. By framing the moment as Han adding a work to her ongoing River Cycle series, it creates narrative momentum and situates this event within the larger story of her tapestry career, which is an effective way to begin a narrative.

Why D is incorrect:

Choice D is incorrect. This choice isn't suited for beginning a narrative about the creation of Threads of the Yangtze. It jumps to the present-day outcome—the tapestries being viewable online—rather than beginning with the historical event of Han unveiling the work. A narrative should start at the beginning of the story, not at its conclusion.
